name: fleet-capital-beams
notes: M2 step 4 gate (B): a beam/capital/brawler fleet doctrine. Compare with fleet-swarm-missiles and fleet-neutral. Single runs 2026-10-12: Swarm built 57% small, missiles 47% of weapons, design missile mounts 51->130; Capital built 25% small, beams 38%, design beams 123->168 and kinetics 67->22; neutral 44% small, missiles/beams 31% each. Engagement (2026-10-16: own range x3, opposite range /3): short-range share of short+long combat builds was neutral 0.26-0.27, Brawler 0.30-0.33, Artillery 0.15-0.26 before. 2026-10-16 (opposite range /3): short share 0.39 (neutral 0.26-0.27, old Brawler 0.30-0.33) -> assert >= 0.35; design beams 145 and 168 vs 123 start -> assert >= 1.15x.
asserts: sum(d['weapons'].get('Beams', 0) for d in events('fleet')[-1]['designs']) >= 1.15 * sum(d['weapons'].get('Beams', 0) for d in events('fleet')[0]['designs'])
sum(d['weapons'].get('Kinetics', 0) for d in events('fleet')[-1]['designs']) <= 0.6 * sum(d['weapons'].get('Kinetics', 0) for d in events('fleet')[0]['designs'])
sum(count('ship-built', size=s) for s in ['Medium', 'Large', 'Huge']) >= 0.6 * count('ship-built')
